name: Rekka
source:
Cocky and cruel, Rekka is one of the enemy shinobi the protagonist faces in the main story. He specializes in fire techniques and using shurikens. While he may seem apathetic in his contract with his master, Rekka is concerned for him.

-Koei wiki http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Geten_no_Hana
